
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22348721" title="发布于 2026-08-09 10:52">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">9. AGENTS.md+memory，把规矩写进Agent脑子</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sR396sETm/" rel="noopener nofollow">《9. AGENTS.md+memory，把规矩写进Agent脑子》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sR396sETm/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>
<p>工具越挂越多，流程细则如果全写进代码里，改一次就要动源码。更稳的做法是分工：system_prompt 负责指定角色，AGENTS.md 负责写清细则；创建 Agent 时用 memory=["./AGENTS.md"] 把细则灌进去，再提问验证是否生效。这样改流程只需改文件，不用改代码。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260809104515563-767068234.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;先在 system_prompt 里补一句：点名角色之后，再要求 Agent 按 AGENTS.md 办事：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>system_prompt=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HarmonyOS 自动化测试专家。严格按 AGENTS.md 的流程和规则执行。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>接着加上 memory=["./AGENTS.md"]。创建时读取该文件，把六步流程、用例规则、禁止项灌进系统提示，细则才真正进脑子：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent():
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent(
        model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
        system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HarmonyOS 自动化测试专家。严格按 AGENTS.md 的流程和规则执行。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        tools</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">get_all_tools(),
        memory</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./AGENTS.md</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
        skills</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./skills/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
        backend</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">LocalShellBackend(
            root_dir</span>=os.getcwd(), virtual_mode=True, inherit_env=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True),
        debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True
    )</span></pre>
</div>
<p>配置好了，把提问改成一段验证用的提示词：让 Agent 说明 AGENTS.md 里的六步流程，并交代不要执行工具、只回答。能按顺序答上来，就说明 memory 起作用了：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent()
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke({
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
            {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">简要说明 AGENTS.md 里自动化测试必须遵守的六步流程是什么？不要执行工具，只回答。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]
    })
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>])</pre>
</div>
<p>能答出六步，说明规矩已经进到 Agent 上下文里。后面真正跑全流程时，它就会按文件里的约定去调工具，而不是只靠一句模糊的 system prompt。</p>
<p>配套动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sR396sETm/" rel="noopener nofollow">《9. AGENTS.md+memory，把规矩写进Agent脑子》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sR396sETm/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>

</div>
